mapper.sql: select distribute_id, doc_id, doc_no, version_no, distribute_type, dept_id, dept_name, user_id, user_name, receive_time, borrow_deadline, return_time, dist_status, watermark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from qms_doc_distribute

mapper.insert: insert into qms_doc_distribute(doc_id, doc_no, version_no, distribute_type, dept_id, dept_name, user_id, user_name, receive_time, borrow_deadline, dist_status, watermark, create_by, create_time, remark) values(#{docId}, #{docNo}, #{versionNo}, #{distributeType}, #{deptId}, #{deptName}, #{userId}, #{userName}, #{receiveTime}, #{borrowDeadline}, #{distStatus}, #{watermark}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
